title: Atlantean Twilight
description: Time ticks away in a far away place in this little new-age piece.

title: Meditation Impromptu 01
description: A single piano impromptu in D flat Major, broken into three files for easier downloading. This piece was made because many people were using my music as background for hypnosis and meditation products. This is a very very calming (and long) piano piece designed for just that. There is nothing startling contained in this piece... only light flowing melodies.
